pairs.target: cìrì de gōnglù chē jiāng tāmen sòngdào huàn chuán chù , tàiyáng hái méi zǒu dào péngdǐng . tǎ wéi xiān tīngjiàn shuǐ , cái kànjiàn chuán : ànbiān yìpái wěizǐ dǎng zhe , jǐgēn cháng gāo cóng wěi hòu xié xié shēnchū lái , xiàng shuí bǎ shūzǐ chājìn le tiānshàng .
pairs.english: Next day's road cart delivered them to the boat transfer before the sun reached the awning. Tavi heard water before seeing boats: reeds screened the bank, long poles slanting above them like a comb stuck in the sky.
pairs.hanzi: 次日的公路车将他们送到换船处，太阳还没走到棚顶。塔维先听见水，才看见船：岸边一排苇子挡着，几根长篙从苇后斜斜伸出来，像谁把梳子插进了天上。

pairs.target: lú shí shì lái jiē zhè yìbān kèrén de chuángōng , nǚrén , sǎngzi yǒu yìdiǎn yǎ , shǒuwàn shài dé bǐ xiǎobì shēn .
pairs.english: Lushi was the boatwoman collecting these passengers, a little hoarse, her wrists tanned darker than her forearms.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实是来接这一班客人的船工，女人，嗓子有一点哑，手腕晒得比小臂深。

pairs.target: tā méi ràng tǎ wéi yí jiàn chuán biàn wǎngxiàzǒu , xiān bǎ liǎngkǔn cài yí dào péngzǐ dǐxià , jiào tā jiāng bāo kòuhǎo , kōng chū shǒufú ànbiān de cūshéng .
pairs.english: She didn't let Tavi rush down on seeing the boat. First she moved two bundles of vegetables under the canopy and told him to fasten his bag, freeing a hand for the thick shore rope.
pairs.hanzi: 她没让塔维一见船便往下走，先把两捆菜移到篷子底下，叫他将包扣好，空出手扶岸边的粗绳。

pairs.target: chuánbiān méiyǒu wěnwěn bú dòng de shíjiē , tàbǎn suí chuán qīngqīng qǐfú , tā zhàn zài lìngyìtóu děng , děng tā jiǎoxià cǎi shí le cái sōngkāi .
pairs.english: There were no steady stone stairs beside the boat. The boarding plank rose and fell gently; she waited at its other end, releasing it only after his feet were secure.
pairs.hanzi: 船边没有稳稳不动的石阶，踏板随船轻轻起伏，她站在另一头等，等他脚下踩实了才松开。

pairs.target: nài lěi rènde tā , què méiyǒu tì tā zhāohū hòumiàn de rén . yígè tiāo zhe liǎnggè kuāng de nánrén yào lián kuāng yìtóng jǐ , lú shí ràng tā xiān xiè yígè , zìjǐ bān guòqù .
pairs.english: Nerai knew her but didn't direct the passengers behind. A man with two carried baskets tried squeezing in with both; Lushi had him unload one and moved it herself.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾认得她，却没有替她招呼后面的人。一个挑着两个筐的男人要连筐一同挤，芦实让他先卸一个，自己搬过去。

pairs.target: nánrén dūnāng shuō shàng huí biàn méi zhème máfán , tā wèn shàng huí tā kuāng lǐ shìfǒu yě zuò zhe yìzhī huó é . kuāng lǐ guǒrán shēnchū yìtiáo bózi , chōngzhe tǎ wéi de xītóu jiào .
pairs.english: The man muttered it hadn't been so troublesome last time. She asked if his basket held a live goose then too. A neck duly emerged, honking at Tavi's knees.
pairs.hanzi: 男人嘟囔说上回便没这么麻烦，她问上回他筐里是否也坐着一只活鹅。筐里果然伸出一条脖子，冲着塔维的膝头叫。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn ràngkāi , zuò dé lí chuán yán tài jìn , chuánshēn yì yáo , wèi lǐ gēnzhe kōng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi hastily moved aside, sitting too near the gunwale. One roll of the boat made his stomach drop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧让开，坐得离船沿太近，船身一摇，胃里跟着空了一下。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi zìjǐ hái méi chī gòu zǎofàn , mō dào bāo lǐ de gān bǐng , nài lěi què ràng tā xiān wàngyuǎn xiē , bié dītóu tóng nà zhī é duì yǎn .
pairs.english: Thinking he hadn't eaten enough breakfast, he felt for dry bread in his bag. Nerai told him to look farther away first, not down into the goose's eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为自己还没吃够早饭，摸到包里的干饼，奈蕾却让他先望远些，别低头同那只鹅对眼。

pairs.target: lú shí bǎ é kuāng nuó dào jiǎo biān , gāo yì chēng , wěizǐ mànmàn cóng tāmen shēnpáng tuì kāi .
pairs.english: Lushi moved the goose basket to her feet and pushed with the pole; reeds slowly slid past them.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实把鹅筐挪到脚边，篙一撑，苇子慢慢从他们身旁退开。

pairs.target: shuǐmiàn bǐ chēshàng kànjiàn de gèng kuān , què bìngfēi chùchù yíyàng . jìnàn yìcéng xì bō , yuǎnchù yǒu yídài yánsè àn xiē , fǎngfú yìtiáo lù yā zài shuǐxià .
pairs.english: The water was wider than it had looked from the cart, and not all alike. Fine ripples lay near shore; farther out a darker band seemed a road beneath the water.
pairs.hanzi: 水面比车上看见的更宽，却并非处处一样。近岸一层细波，远处有一带颜色暗些，仿佛一条路压在水下。

pairs.target: lú shí yán pángbiān xíng , bù cóng nà yídài zhèngzhōng chuān . tā shuō nà shì zhǔliú , búshì huà zài shuǐ lǐ de chēzhé , shěng jǐbù jiǎo de xiǎngfǎ biébān dào chuánshàng lái .
pairs.english: Lushi traveled beside it, not through the middle. That was the main current, she said, not wheel ruts drawn in water; saving a few steps wasn't a notion to bring aboard.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实沿旁边行，不从那一带正中穿。她说那是主流，不是画在水里的车辙，省几步脚的想法别搬到船上来。

pairs.target: fēngdài zhe shī cǎo yǔ chái yān de wèidào . tǎ wéi jiànjiàn búzài dīng zhe zìjǐ huì buhuì tǔ , tái yǎn kànjiàn duìàn yǒu yìjiān wūzi de mén kāi zhe , ménqián yìshuāng xié , què bú xiàng luò zài dìshàng .
pairs.english: Wind smelled of wet grass and woodsmoke. Tavi gradually stopped wondering if he'd vomit and saw an open door across the water, a pair of shoes before it seemingly off the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 风带着湿草与柴烟的味道。塔维渐渐不再盯着自己会不会吐，抬眼看见对岸有一间屋子的门开着，门前一双鞋，却不像落在地上。

pairs.target: chuán zài jìn xiē , cái jiàn xié bǎizài yíduàn fú mù shàng , mù yǔ mù yòng shéng lǒng zhe , wū dǐ de héngliáng yā zài shàngtóu , bèihòu lìng yǒu lǎn lián xiàng ànshàng de zhuāng .
pairs.english: Closer, he saw the shoes on floating logs lashed with ropes, the house's crossbeams resting on them, cables behind reaching shore posts.
pairs.hanzi: 船再近些，才见鞋摆在一段浮木上，木与木用绳拢着，屋底的横梁压在上头，背后另有缆连向岸上的桩。

pairs.target: yíwèi lǎorén zuòzài mén lǐ bāo dōngxī , pí suíshǒu diū jìn lǒu , bù wǎng shuǐ lǐ rēng . tā yě kànjiàn chuán lái , xiàng lú shí wèn jīnrì yǒuméiyǒu dài miànfěn .
pairs.english: An old man sat peeling something in his doorway, dropping skins in a basket rather than the water. Seeing the boat, he asked Lushi if she'd brought flour today.
pairs.hanzi: 一位老人坐在门里剥东西，皮随手丢进篓，不往水里扔。他也看见船来，向芦实问今日有没有带面粉。

pairs.target: tā shuō xià yìbān , lǎorén biàn zhǐzhe tā jiǎo biān nà zhī é , shuō nà zhī dǎo néng mó . tā zìjǐ xiān xiào qǐlái , tiāo kuāng de nánrén zhǐhǎo shuō é bú mài , dàn cái mài .
pairs.english: She said next crossing. He pointed at the goose by her feet and said it could grind. Laughing at his own joke, he left the basket man explaining only the eggs were for sale, not the goose.
pairs.hanzi: 她说下一班，老人便指着她脚边那只鹅，说那只倒能磨。他自己先笑起来，挑筐的男人只好说鹅不卖，蛋才卖。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng bǎ zhè yímù huà xiàlái , shǒu què réng dé fúzhù zuò bǎn . tā jiāng lǎorén ménbiān liàngzhe de liǎnggēn hóng shéng jì zài xīnlǐ , xiǎng yíhuì shàngàn zàirèn .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to draw the scene but still had to hold the seat board. He remembered two red cords drying by the door, intending to identify the house after landing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想把这一幕画下来，手却仍得扶住座板。他将老人门边晾着的两根红绳记在心里，想一会上岸再认。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn tā táishǒu yòu fàngxià , méiyǒu tì tā nábǐ , zìjǐ bǎ màoyán yādī , dǎlegè duǎnduǎnde hāqian .
pairs.english: Nerai watched him raise and lower his hand without fetching his pen, and lowered her hat brim for a short yawn.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看他抬手又放下，没有替他拿笔，自己把帽檐压低，打了个短短的哈欠。

pairs.target: chuán kàoàn shí , tǎ wéi wàngjiàn jiù tú shàng de shíjiē , zuì xià jǐjí yǐjīng pào zài shuǐ lǐ , qīngtái liánchéngyípiàn .
pairs.english: As the boat approached shore Tavi saw the old map's stone stairs, lower steps already underwater, moss joined in a sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 船靠岸时，塔维望见旧图上的石阶，最下几级已经泡在水里，青苔连成一片。

pairs.target: lú shí méi bǎ chuán kào guòqù , rào dào nánbiān yíkuài suìshí àn , liǎnggè xiàchuán de rén xiān bǎ cài jiē zǒu , tā cái ràng tāmen cǎi shàngpù hǎo de mùbǎn .
pairs.english: Lushi instead brought the boat to a southern gravel bank. Two people ashore took the vegetables first, then she let her passengers step onto the laid planks.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实没把船靠过去，绕到南边一块碎石岸，两个下船的人先把菜接走，她才让他们踩上铺好的木板。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiǎotà dào dìmiàn , jìng juéde àn yě zài qīngwēi dì yáo , zhàn le yíhuìer , cái fājué shì zìjǐ hái méi huǎn guòlái .
pairs.english: On solid ground Tavi felt the shore swaying slightly too. After standing a while he realized he simply hadn't recovered yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脚踏到地面，竟觉得岸也在轻微地摇，站了一会儿，才发觉是自己还没缓过来。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiāng chuánqián liántóng tú shàng wènlù de gōngqián fēnkāi gěi lú shí , yuē tā míngrì shàngwǔ ruò néng téngchū shíhòu , péi zhe rèn liǎngchù àn lù .
pairs.english: Nerai paid Lushi the fare separately from map-consultation wages and asked if she could spare time the next morning to identify two shore approaches.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾将船钱连同图上问路的工钱分开给芦实，约她明日上午若能腾出时候，陪着认两处岸路。

pairs.target: lú shí fānkàn zìjǐ wǔhòu de chuán cì , dāying míngzǎo dìyībān sòng wán yǐhòu , bié ná yíshàngwǔ suàn chéng yìzhěngtiān , jiào tā diū le hòutou de kè .
pairs.english: Lushi checked her afternoon crossings and agreed after tomorrow's first trip, warning not to turn one morning into a whole day and cost her later passengers.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实翻看自己午后的船次，答应明早第一班送完以后，别拿一上午算成一整天，叫她丢了后头的客。

pairs.target: huòzhàn de mù guǎnshì zài ànshàng děng , xiān wèn xíngli , bāng tāmen bǎ túbǎn bān dào yīnchù .
pairs.english: Warehouse steward Mou waited ashore, asked about luggage, and helped move their drawing boards into shade.
pairs.hanzi: 货栈的牟管事在岸上等，先问行李，帮他们把图板搬到阴处。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe yìtiáo zhítōng huòzhàn ménkǒu de zhǎilù , shuō xīn tú ruò néng xiān bǎ kèrén dàidào zhèlǐ , zǒng hǎo guò ràng rén xiàchuán biàn wǎng fú wūlǐ luàn zhǎo . nài lěi shuō xiān zǒuyíbiàn , míngrì zài kàn lìngyìtóu , méi zài kōng zhǐ shàng tì tā huà dìng nàge jiàntóu .
pairs.english: He pointed to a narrow path straight to the warehouse gate: better for the new map to lead visitors here than have them wander among floating homes after landing. Nerai would walk it first and inspect the other end tomorrow, not fixing his arrow on blank paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他指着一条直通货栈门口的窄路，说新图若能先把客人带到这里，总好过让人下船便往浮屋里乱找。奈蕾说先走一遍，明日再看另一头，没在空纸上替他画定那个箭头。

pairs.target: tāmen zhù jìn ànshàng qīngwǎ de kèdiàn , chuāng lǐ néng kànjiàn shuǐ , chuángjiǎo què tātāshishí zài dìshàng .
pairs.english: They lodged at a blue-tiled inn ashore, water visible from its windows but bed legs firmly on ground.
pairs.hanzi: 他们住进岸上青瓦的客店，窗里能看见水，床脚却踏踏实实在地上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng bāo fàngxià , xiān qù xǐliǎn , fāxiànzìjǐ xiùkǒu zhān le yìgēn é de xìmáo , niān diào shí hūrán yòu xiǎngqǐ lǎorén nàshuāng xié .
pairs.english: Tavi set down his pack and washed his face, finding a fine goose feather on his cuff. Picking it off, he remembered the old man's shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将包放下，先去洗脸，发现自己袖口沾了一根鹅的细毛，拈掉时忽然又想起老人那双鞋。

pairs.target: tā tóng nài lěi shuō ménbiān yǒu liǎnggēn hóng shéng , huòxǔ néng xiān zài tú shàng jìzhù nà jiān wū . tā shuō kěyǐ xiān jì , míngrì wènqīng shìfǒu chángyòng zhège zuòjìhào .
pairs.english: He told Nerai of two red cords by the door, perhaps a way to mark the house on the map for now. She said note them, then ask tomorrow whether they were its regular marker.
pairs.hanzi: 他同奈蕾说门边有两根红绳，或许能先在图上记住那间屋。她说可以先记，明日问清是否常用这个作记号。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , tānkāi zhǐ xiān huà wū dǐ de fú mù , huà dào ménkǒu , méi jiāng nàshuāng xié yě dàngchéng yǒngyuǎn búhuì dòng de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded and began drawing the logs beneath the house. Reaching the doorway, he didn't treat the shoes as something that would never move.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，摊开纸先画屋底的浮木，画到门口，没将那双鞋也当成永远不会动的东西。
